name: qemu-alpine-docker
description: Persistent pure-TCG QEMU Alpine Docker VM for Testcontainers development and testing on Windows.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent Alpine Docker VM for Windows Testcontainers.
interface.longDescription: Creates and manages one unattended, persistent Alpine Docker VM using pure QEMU TCG and user networking. Exposes a loopback Docker API and a bounded random port range for host-side Testcontainers while preserving pulled image layers between runs.
defaultPrompt: Set up a QEMU Alpine VM with Docker for development.
Start the Alpine VM and sync project code.
Run host Testcontainers tests against Docker in the Alpine VM.
